capabilities: Chat with a local pi agent over a WebSocket relay
Attach the active note path, selection, or body as context to every message
Write agent answers back into the current note at the cursor or replacing the selection
Attach images and vault or phone files to messages
Switch model and thinking level live and manage pi sessions
disambiguation: Not a Raspberry Pi utility; 'pi' here is the coding agent running in Termux that the panel drives.
extras: The relay token is stored in plain text in data.json; the agent is not sandboxed by the plugin and runs with Termux user privileges; setup for the Termux side lives in relay/README.en.md rather than the main README.
motivation: A mobile Obsidian plugin cannot spawn a process, so the agent has to live outside, and pi's RPC mode rejects @file arguments, so the active note is embedded in each message instead.
problem: A mobile Obsidian plugin cannot spawn a process, so running an AI agent from inside Obsidian on a phone requires an outside helper plus a way to pass note context.

relations.evidence: The agent runs in Termux (where it can spawn processes, use skills, MCP servers and your vault index)

requires.name: pi and the pi-relay relay running in Termux

summary: Chat panel that talks to a local pi agent running in Termux, sending the active note as context and writing answers back into it.
